notes.title: Update Demo-version
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058884/b8877c9781b3f8bf7089f6f4bbe11bc15543c214.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058884/f13274abf03807f642880a66f981c1d62ead2c3a.png[/img][/url]

We made some fixes to the demo and want you to check it out:
1) The tutorial has been completely reworked. Less text, more action :)
2) We added autocast as an option for hero action skills.
3) Added a planning line for using skills and consumables during the active pause.
4) Some balance improvements (you will like it).
5) Some small bug fixes.

Thanks for all your feedback, it helps a lot. 
And like always - Roguelike?.. Rogue like a Greek, Traveler ;)
